title: wildro event import
description: The input of `events import`. This file is the contract: the command validates every document against it before anything is written, and it is also what a language model is told to follow. Read docs/event-import.md before writing a document. Every object rejects unknown keys, because a typo in a field name would otherwise mean silently lost data.

events.description: One or more events. A batch is applied wholly or not at all.

instant.description: RFC 3339 date-time with an explicit offset, e.g. 2026-10-03T09:00:00+02:00. A time without an offset would let the server's zone decide what it means.

slug.description: The public address of the event page and the key a repeated import updates. Lowercase ASCII words joined by single hyphens. A recurring event keeps one slug with no date in it; only a one-off event may carry its date.

status.description: DRAFT stays off the public side. PUBLISHED is visible. Cancelling is a separate command, never a value here.

difficulty.description: Only if the source says so. Omit the key rather than guess.

startPoint.description: Where the outing starts, in WGS 84 degrees. Named keys rather than a pair, so latitude and longitude cannot be swapped. Set by a human when the source does not name an exact start point; never estimated.

organizer.description: The group or person running it, as plain text from the source. Not an account.

source.description: Where the event is announced and when it was read. Both back the 'check the source' line on the page.

distanceKm.description: Only if the source says so.

elevationGainM.description: Only if the source says so.

coverCredit.description: Required with coverImageUrl, and only with it: the photo's author, its licence as written by the archive (e.g. 'CC BY-SA 4.0'), the licence text's address and the original's page. Only freely licensed photos (Wikimedia Commons and the like) or the owner's own; never a photo taken from the organiser's page.

price.description: Only if the source says what taking part costs. The regular adult price; 0 when free. Other prices (children, members) stay in the description. Omit the key rather than guess.

coverImageUrl.description: Optional. An event without a cover is the normal case.

links.description: Optional, beside the source link. Only addresses the source itself names; never searched for or guessed. Telegram, Instagram, WhatsApp and Facebook are shown with their own mark, anything else by its host name.

event.description: Where this one outing lives on a network or in a messenger: its post, its event page, its chat.

community.description: Where the group running it can be found: its channel, its profile, its group chat.

translations.description: All three languages, always. The description is written in our own words, never copied from the source.

placeName.description: The place in words, in this language, country name included. The card must not mix languages.
